references.text: Describes Eleazar's lineage as the son of Aaron, and that he took one of Putiel's daughters as his wife, who bore him Phinehas.
Eleazar is mentioned as Aaron's son who was to serve as a priest alongside his father.
Tells of Aaron's death and how Eleazar succeeded him as high priest on Mount Hor.
Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, is noted for his zeal and receives an everlasting covenant of priesthood from the Lord.
Eleazar the priest is mentioned as one who was to distribute the inherited land among the tribes of Israel.
Eleazar the priest is mentioned in connection with the distribution of the inherited land in Canaan.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua divided the inheritance by casting lots before the Lord.
The heads of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest to receive their cities.
Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, served before the ark of the covenant of the Lord at that time.
